item.name: Private Patch Reef Fishing
item.description:
##Description
Key West's Coastal Odyssey: A Fishing Adventure in Crystal Waters - Includes light tackle, drop fishing, drifting & trolling. Chum & Live bait purchased separately.

##Duration
4, 6, 8 Hours

##About
A private patch reef or flats fishing trip in Key West, with light outfits and tackle, is an unforgettable adventure into crystal-clear waters, where the early morning sun hints at the day's potential. Heading to vibrant reefs, anglers find ecosystems teeming with fish like snapper and grouper, offering excitement and significant catches. Alternatively, the serene flats provide tranquil sight fishing for bonefish and tarpon, challenging anglers to spot and stalk. Guided by experienced captains. The day's weather and tide determine where the captain will take you. We provide top-notch fishing gear & tackle 

##Extra
All charter passengers may use The Perry Hotel and Marina Pools as my guests before and after the charter. David, Owner
item.booking_notes:
IMPORTANT ACTION REQUIRED
Six Fins Charter – Patch Reef Fishing Confirmation

Dear Guests,

We’re excited to welcome you aboard your Private Patch Reef Fishing Charter in Key West.

Whether you're chasing snapper for dinner or simply enjoying a relaxed day on the water, we look forward to hosting your adventure.

Please review the important details below to ensure a smooth and successful trip.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

✅ Before Your Trip

For trips up to six passengers:

👉 Each passenger must complete the insurance waiver (including adults on behalf of minors): [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/rd9k5tiavpwper7h2rhaqh/web/)

For trips with 7th and 8th passengers:

👉 The primary renter (21+ years old) must complete the Bareboat Contract prior to arrival: [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/gntbqof57vuo1dg62v383i/web/

All required forms must be completed before arrival so we may depart on time.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🎣 Your Fishing Experience

You’ve reserved a private charter for:

4 Hours – $1,395
6 Hours – $1,595
8 Hours – $1,795

We’ll target productive patch reefs just a few miles offshore near areas such as:

• Sand Key Reef
• Western Sambo Reef
• Eastern Dry Rocks
• Rock Key

Target species may include:

• Yellowtail Snapper
• Mangrove Snapper
• Mutton Snapper
• Grouper (seasonal regulations apply)
• Hogfish (season permitting)
• Porgies
• Spanish Mackerel
• Bonito
• Seasonal mahi-mahi

Fishing success varies daily — but we’ll work hard to keep rods bent and lines tight.

All tackle and gear are provided. Your catch will be iced onboard.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🛥 Departure Details

Dock A, Slip #32
7001 Shrimp Rd
Stock Island, FL 33040

Free parking is available adjacent to The Perry Hotel & Marina.
Please arrive 15 minutes prior to departure.

Boat:
30' Jeanneau NC 895 Weekender
Private enclosed head (toilet)
USCG-certified safety equipment
Licensed USCG captains

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🧳 What’s Included

• All rods, reels, tackle & bait
• Cooler with ice
• Bottled water & light snacks
• Licensed vessel fishing coverage

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🚫 Not Included

• Meals & additional beverages
• Towels
• Infant/toddler USCG-approved life jackets (must be provided by guest)
• Captain & crew gratuity (customary 20% minimum if satisfied)

All catches must comply with Florida Fish & Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC) size and bag limits.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🩺 Health & Safety

Your safety is our highest priority.

• Operated by U.S. Coast Guard–licensed captains
• Safety briefing provided before departure
• USCG-approved life jackets available
• Required safety equipment onboard at all times
• Food allergies or dietary restrictions: reply to this email and let us know in advance so we can prepare.
• Prone to seasickness: tell us ahead of time and we'll suggest what to take before boarding.

Guests should be comfortable standing, handling rods, and moving safely on deck.

Excessive intoxication or unsafe behavior may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.

Captains reserve the right to modify location or return early due to weather or sea conditions.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

⚠ Disclaimers

• Fishing success cannot be guaranteed.
• Species availability varies by season and regulation.
• All itineraries are subject to weather and captain discretion.
• Late arrivals may reduce charter time without refund.
• Six Fins is not responsible for lost or damaged personal items.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🎁 Complimentary Access

As my charter guests, you may enjoy access to The Perry Hotel & Marina pools and fitness center before and after your trip.

Turn your fishing trip into a full Keys day.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

We look forward to fishing with you.

Best regards,

David McFadden
Owner, Six Fins Charter
item.cancellation_notes:
Enjoy peace of mind with our cancellation policy:

All reservations made within 7 calendar days of departure are non-refundable. Customer cancellations made prior to 7 calendar days before departure will receive a full refund. If Six Fins Charter cancels due to unsafe weather conditions or other circumstances initiated by the owner/operator, the customer will receive a full refund.
